'''Daskarta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] she coordinates the evacuation of refugees from the collapsing Makeb mesas. However, many of her efforts were undone by the [[InterStellar Regulators]] based on the [[Frinn Mesa]], who used heavy artillery to bring the transports full of refugees down. After losing [[Banlon]], Daskarta asked a Republic strike team to storm the Regulators' fortress and disable the artillery.
